messages:
Alex: FYI seeing a sudden egress spike from keystore shards in us-east-1, NAT-GW alarms firing since ~08:40 UTC :warning:
ops-bot: ALERT nat-gw-conn-exhaustion us-east-1 prod-natgw-3 (threshold breached)
Maria: I also see KMS audit export throughput up 6x, and VPC flow logs bytes outbound spiked at the same time
Jamal: Did someone change flow log sampling or cross-account replication for audit buckets recently?
Alex: I rolled a policy tweak earlier to enable cross-account audit replication for compliance, and bumped flow log sampling to 100% for a short window to debug an unrelated issue
Tina: quick metrics dump:
```
aws cloudwatch get-metric-statistics --metric-name NetworkBytesOut --namespace AWS/NATGateway --start-time 2026-03-19T08:20:00Z --end-time 2026-03-19T09:00:00Z
--> 08:30-08:45: 420GB
--> 08:45-09:00: 1.8TB
```
Jamal: Ouch. That plus cross-account S3 replication means double egress. Also saw a flurry of KMS Decrypt errors from gpu-warmpool nodes at ~08:42, causing the autoscaler to spin extra nodes (churn -> more keystore traffic)
Alex: Correct. Warmpool nodes couldn't fetch keys (502 decrypt) so they failed healthchecks and restarted, then retried bootstrap which triggered more KMS calls
Maria: Immediate mitigations we can do now:
- reduce VPC flow log sampling to 1% (rollback my debug change)
- pause cross-account replication on audit bucket (temp)
- set KMS export batching/compression for audit stream if possible
Jamal: + route keystore traffic to PrivateLink endpoint for keystore (cuts NAT egress). Can we flip that quickly?
Tina: PrivateLink exists but needs the endpoint policy tweak (I can deploy it, 10–15m). In meantime, I can bump autoscaler backoff to avoid churn (reduce scale-up aggressiveness)
Alex: I've seen the SG tweak from earlier, posting it: 
```
# earlier change
allow outbound s3 0.0.0.0/0
allow outbound kms 0.0.0.0/0
# we should scope to privatelink subnets instead
```
Maria: Also noticed a KMS key policy update that added an external principal for replication — that caused extra use of re-encrypt for objects. Rolling that back will stop some traffic
Jamal: Can someone estimate cost delta for this spike? We need to know if this will hit monthly budget alerts
Maria: Rough calc: extra 1.4TB egress (~us-east inter-AZ -> NAT & cross-account double) ~= $1200 for the window, plus extra GPU node runtime ~3h = ~$900. Ballpark $2k for the event window
Tina: Plan: (1) reduce flow logs sampling now (Alex/Tina) (2) pause replication (Maria) (3) enable PrivateLink endpoint policy (Tina) (4) throttle autoscaler and add backoff (Jamal) (5) create alert on KMS decrypt error rate (Alex)
Jamal: I'll open a short incident ticket and assign ops-run for the rollout and rollback steps, and put a status update in #incidents
Alex: Good. After stabilizing we'll do a short postmortem and add a config test to detect when audit replication would double egress. Also add an alert that correlates KMS decrypt errors + autoscaler scale-ups
Maria: One more: add a runbook step to prefer compressed batch export for audit logs — that should be default to avoid surprise spikes
ops-bot: ack: incident created INC-2026-0443, assignees: Alex, Maria, Tina, Jamal
Alex: Thanks everyone. I'll start reducing sampling and post updates in this thread :thumbsup:
